review_scope: Narrow observation-compatible comparison only; no workload or admission-policy change

primary_sources.finding: The ServiceAccount admission implementation selects one kube-api-access-prefixed volume name, appends a read-only mount at the fixed service-account path to both init and ordinary containers lacking that path, and creates its projected volume when needed.
The official description documents token-volume and per-container mount injection when automount is enabled; containers already mounting the standard path are skipped.

For declared matchLabelKeys, the API server resolves incoming Pod label values and merges the result into labelSelector. Since v1.34 that merge is explicit. The documentation identifies pod-template-hash as a revision-specific use case.
PrepareForCreate invokes topology-spread mutation. Each constraint applies declared matchLabelKeys to its labelSelector using the In operator and the incoming Pod labels.

required_comparison_boundary.init_containers: Preserve count, order and every original field; normalize only one exact additional read-only service-account mount, bound to the same single observed extra projected kube-api-access volume used by the main container.
required_comparison_boundary.topology_spread: Preserve every original constraint field. A merge difference is eligible only when the template declares pod-template-hash in matchLabelKeys, and only one added expression may use that exact key, the In operator and a single value equal to the owning ReplicaSet and Pod revision hash.
required_comparison_boundary.replicaset_binding: Use the already-read ReplicaSet to bind its revision hash to the Pod label; never pin the old observed revision value across a new rollout.
required_comparison_boundary.unknown_differences: Reject other fields, mount paths/options, selector expressions, values, keys, topologyKey or maxSkew changes.
